sylvan esso|hot slob.fact: Hot Slob is Sylvan Esso's first new single since 2022's No Rules Sandy, released in 2026 on their own label, Psychic Hotline. It features drummer TJ Maiani (Weyes Blood, Neneh Cherry) and Jenn Wasner of Wye Oak on extra guitar and vocals.

sylvan esso|concrete glen.fact: Concrete Glen, from Sylvan Esso's 2026 album Ow, samples Sigur Ros' "Svefn-g-englar" - a band singer Amelia Meath has said soundtracked a lot of her childhood.

king gizzard & the lizard wizard|crumbli.fact: Crumbling Castle's home album, Polygondwanaland, was released by King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard under an open license with the master tapes posted online for free - inviting fans and small labels to press and remix it however they liked. Hundreds of different fan-made editions exist, including a K.K. Slider-style Animal Crossing tribute pressed on vinyl.

r.e.m.|orange crush.fact: R.E.M.'s Orange Crush is a quietly anti-war song - the title nods to Agent Orange, the defoliant used in the Vietnam War, drawing on singer Michael Stipe's memories of growing up on Army bases where his father served. The subtlety worked almost too well: a British TV host once introduced it on air as "great on a summer's day."

bon iver|holocene.fact: Bon Iver's Holocene takes its title from both the current geological epoch and a bar in Portland, Oregon. Its three verses trace three different moments from Justin Vernon's life in his hometown of Eau Claire, Wisconsin, and the music video was filmed among Iceland's glaciers.

coldplay|don't panic.fact: Don't Panic was the very first song Coldplay ever played live, at their debut gig at The Laurel Tree in Camden, London, in January 1998 - two years before it appeared, reworked with a pump organ, on their debut album Parachutes.

the smiths|still ill.fact: The Smiths' Still Ill got its title from a real conversation - Morrissey's friend, artist Linder Sterling, greeted him at a weekly rooftop-restaurant meetup by asking, "Are you still ill?"

vampire weekend|run.fact: Vampire Weekend's Ezra Koenig has said Run, from 2010's Contra, was written with Bruce Springsteen's Born to Run in mind.

my morning jacket|i will sing you songs.fact: My Morning Jacket recorded It Still Moves, home to the nearly eight-minute I Will Sing You Songs, at Above the Cadillac Studios in rural Shelbyville, Kentucky - with the album's horn parts tracked separately at Memphis's famous Royal Studios.
